limits: This is a byte codec and explicit-reference verifier, not a scientific, terminal-job, sealed-release or transitive evidence-closure validator. Root must select stable already-reviewed JSONL and include all required dependencies before any real use.

No real raw was packed, migrated, deleted, rewritten or replaced with a pointer; no existing receipt or Git index/history was altered. Existing staging validation has not been replaced or archive-aware integration accepted.

Each final file is published exclusively and atomically, but multi-file publication is not a filesystem-wide crash transaction; a failed publication phase may leave a fully verified subset. Same-byte retry is supported and different-byte files are never overwritten.

Real symbolic-link creation remains untested in the author environment because Windows denied privilege; no elevation was attempted. The four independent real Windows junction tests passed, but they are not substituted for symbolic-link tests.
Same-codec deterministic compression is verified; compressed byte equality across Python/zlib versions is not assumed. Stored compressed SHA/bytes are authoritative.
Root real-byte-copy roundtrip and future staged package/clone audit are separate pending steps, not claimed by this receipt.
